body.zh-Hant: 舒阿爾（Ernest Chuard）1857年7月31日生於科爾塞勒—普雷—派爾訥，1942年11月9日卒於洛桑，是化學博士。1907至1919年任國民院議員，1909至1912年並任大議會議員。1912年他當選州參事會（Staatsrat）成員，1912至1917年主管教育與宗教部，1917至1919年主管農業、商業與工業部。
body.en: Ernest Chuard was born at Corcelles-près-Payerne on 31 July 1857 and died in Lausanne on 9 November 1942; he held a doctorate in chemistry. He sat in the National Council in 1907–1919 and also in a cantonal Grand Council in 1909–1912. Elected to the cantonal Staatsrat in 1912, he headed the education and worship department in 1912–1917 and the agriculture, trade and industry department in 1917–1919.

body.zh-Hant: 1919至1928年舒阿爾是聯邦政府（Landesregierung）成員。聯邦議會否決了沃州自由派的官方人選馬耶弗，在第五輪投票把席位給了舒阿爾，而他並未謀求此職。他接掌內政部，1924年任聯邦主席。
body.en: From 1919 to 1928 Chuard was a member of the Swiss federal government. The Federal Assembly rejected Paul Maillefer, the official candidate of the Vaud Radicals, and awarded the seat to Chuard on the fifth ballot, although he had not sought the office. He took over the Department of the Interior and served as Federal President in 1924.

body.zh-Hant: 帕希奇1845年12月18日（格里曆12月30日）生於塞爾維亞扎耶查爾，1926年12月10日卒於貝爾格勒。他自1868年起以塞爾維亞國家獎學金生身分就讀聯邦理工學院，1872年取得工程師文憑。他於1891至1892年及1904至1918年（中斷三次）出任塞爾維亞總理，並於1921年至1926年去世前不久出任1918年成立的塞爾維亞—克羅埃西亞—斯洛維尼亞王國的首相。
body.en: Pašić was born at Zaječar in Serbia on 18 December 1845 (30 December in the Gregorian calendar) and died in Belgrade on 10 December 1926. From 1868 he studied at the Federal Polytechnic as a Serbian state scholarship holder and received his engineering diploma in 1872. He was Prime Minister of Serbia in 1891–1892 and 1904–1918 (with three interruptions), and from 1921 until shortly before his death in 1926 prime minister of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes founded in 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 溫尼琴科1880年7月27日生於赫爾松省的韋利基庫特村，1951年3月6日卒於法國穆然。1902年他因「革命」活動被基輔大學開除。他是烏克蘭社會民主工黨（USDRP）的領袖，被選為中央拉達兩位副主席之一，繼而成為中央拉達總書記處的首任主席。他領導反對派的烏克蘭民族聯盟，其後自督政府成立的1918年起領導督政府至1919年2月；《當代烏克蘭百科全書》寫他於1918年11月起領導督政府。
body.en: Vynnychenko was born on 27 July 1880 in the village of Velykyi Kut in Kherson gubernia and died on 6 March 1951 in Mougins, France. He was expelled from Kyiv University in 1902 for 'revolutionary' activities. As leader of the USDRP he was chosen one of the two vice-presidents of the Central Rada and then first president of its General Secretariat. He headed the oppositional Ukrainian National Union and then led the Directory of the Ukrainian National Republic from its creation in 1918 until February 1919; the Encyclopedia of Modern Ukraine says he took charge of the Directory in November 1918.

people.name: József Ágost főherceg (Archduke Joseph August of Austria)

body.zh-Hant: 約瑟夫·奧古斯特出自哈布斯堡家族的匈牙利（nádori）支系，1872年生於阿爾奇特，GND 另載他卒於1962年，卒地施特勞賓。1918年秋他以「homo regius」身分在布達佩斯代理並代表卡爾四世，並在革命影響下向君主建議任命卡羅伊·米哈伊為首相。1919年8月蘇維埃共和國垮台後，他援引先前的 homo regius 身分宣布自己為「kormányzó」（攝政／總督），但因國際上的不信任與抗議，只能保有兩週多一點。
body.en: Joseph August came from the Hungarian palatinal branch of the Habsburg family and was born at Alcsút in 1872; the GND record gives his death in 1962 at Straubing. In autumn 1918, as 'homo regius', he deputised for and represented Charles IV in Budapest, and under the pressure of revolution proposed Mihály Károlyi's appointment as prime minister. After the fall of the Soviet Republic in August 1919 he declared himself 'kormányzó' (governor/regent) on the strength of that earlier status, but because of international distrust and protest he held it for little more than two weeks.

body.zh-Hant: 范澤蘭（1893–1973）生於蘇瓦尼，1973年9月22日卒於布魯塞爾。他取得魯汶大學法學博士（1921）與政治及外交科學博士（1923），1928至1964年在魯汶任教授，1926年任國家銀行董事，1934至1935年任副總裁。
body.en: Van Zeeland (1893–1973) was born in Soignies and died in Brussels on 22 September 1973. He took a doctorate in law (1921) and one in political and diplomatic sciences (1923) at Leuven, was professor at Leuven in 1928–1964, director of the National Bank in 1926 and its vice-governor in 1934–1935.

body.zh-Hant: 1934年6月他在德布羅克維爾內閣任不管部大臣，至11月止。1935年3月至1936年6月，他以議會外人士身分組成附貶值方案的全國聯合政府，並在該政府中保留外交部；1936年6月第二屆三黨內閣成立，1937年10月被迫下台。《寰宇百科》稱他是1935至1937年「國家革新政府」的首相。1937年4月11日他以全國候選人身分在補選中大勝德格雷勒。
body.en: In June 1934 he became minister without portfolio in the De Broqueville government, until November 1934. From March 1935 to June 1936 he formed, as an extra-parliamentary figure, a national-union government with a devaluation programme, keeping the Foreign Affairs ministry in it; the second three-party Van Zeeland cabinet was formed in June 1936 and had to resign in October 1937. Universalis calls him prime minister of a government of national renewal in 1935–1937. On 11 April 1937, as the national candidate, he clearly defeated Léon Degrelle in a by-election.
